name: timezone_report_bug
goal: Customers in some timezones say the daily sales report shows yesterday's totals, and a few orders placed near midnight show up on the wrong day. Find out why and fix it so every report (today's report, a specific day, yesterday, multi-day breakdowns, week-to-date, and the CLI) follows the customer's own timezone, including on daylight-saving change days. Don't break customers in UTC.
